A.notes: Fraunces italic emphasis with Plus Jakarta; floating status chips; custom system-permission dialog, denied state with retry, undo toast, reminder time picker, completion step, Escape handling. Desktop frame is frameless and a little plain; progress is segments plus step label. Screenshots show only step 1 so later steps judged from source.

B.notes: Charming smiling-pot mascot, phone bezel on desktop, confetti finish. Fails contrast (white on #2f8f5b 4.04, Skip and subcopy 4.31). Four h1s, 5 touch targets under 44px, 7 radii. Thinner state coverage: no denied-state UI beyond text toast, no undo. Illustration floats with large empty space; tight gap between subcopy and CTA.

why: A passes every gate and has much deeper state design (permission dialog, denied recovery, undo, time choice) with a refined type pairing. B is cute but fails contrast, has multiple h1s and small targets, and is thinner on UX.
